title: Cross-state fire-risk prioritisation surface
note: Serves the rangeland fire-risk index as a day-partitioned Parquet lane, one day per read, per RUNBOOK 0.41.7. Measured AUC 0.725 in-sample on 2026 (0.697 for VPD alone -- do NOT sell the composite as a large gain). STRATIFIED: scores greenness quartiles 1-2 only; skill decays to 0.586 in closed forest and applying it there is a misuse. Feature window must close before the outcome window opens (RUNBOOK 0.41.2). Validation of the skill estimate is a separate track and is blocked on the historical backfill.
